statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
CPT code 93271 (external cardiac event monitoring) was billed
The billed balance for this service is 297.4
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management
This service is medically necessary to document the frequency and duration of atrial fibrillation episodes and to inform stroke risk assessment
